_comment: Permission model phase 2 (guard narrowing, reduced). The interpreter code-string relaxation (b) is deferred until the aptly-signer is live (Verifier round 1 found reachable publish forms it opened; architecture review phase-2 row). This file covers the kept changes: (a) rule A's trigger is an expansion where a command may be built from it - a group that runs something, a reader whose output reaches a runner by pipe, a file a runner names, or a substitution an exposed command consumes; (c) 2>&1 is a fd duplication. denied: forms that must stay denied. allowed: forms newly allowed. Strings are data.
